items.title: Tamil Nadu rain alert: IMD warns of heavy rain in Theni Ghat areas, thunderstorms across state till Saturday as northeast monsoon revives after weeks of deficit
items.summary: Heavy rain is expected in the Ghat areas of Theni district, along with continued thunderstorms across Tamil Nadu. Chennai is anticipated to see only isolated light rainfall until the end of November. The recent rains have positively affected reservoir levels in southern Tamil Nadu, although storage remains lower than last year. A low-pressure area may develop over the south Andaman Sea, but its trajectory is uncertain.

items.title: THE BUTTERFLY LOVERS
items.summary: Ballet, storytelling, drama, exquisite choreography, and an extraordinary array of acrobatic staging make The Butterfly Lovers a feast for the senses, based on a classic love story from Chinese heritage between Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai. Described as a contemporary acrobatic production, it tells of a young woman who disguises herself as a man to be allowed to study. Drawn to a fellow student, she falls in love, but as she prepares to reveal her true identity, her family arrange an advantageous match with another man. Family loyalty and true love come into conflict in a tragedy of epic scale.

items.title: CHIC Exhibition
items.venue: Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre – Exhibition Hall 1
items.summary: CHIC Exhibition continues to celebrate its success and achievements, having welcomed more than 35,000 visitors. The exhibition is pleased to announce its 13th edition (November Edition), taking place from 29 November to 2 December 2026 at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre. CHIC Exhibition is a distinguished shopping destination showcasing a wide range of local and international businesses and brands. It brings together numerous projects and exhibitors under one roof, featuring a diverse selection of fashion, abayas, perfumes, cosmetics, accessories, jewellery, handicrafts, and more. The exhibition offers visitors a comprehensive shopping experience that celebrates diversity and creativity while supporting entrepreneurs and business owners.

items.title: Spacetoon Concert – Muscat
items.venue: Madinat Al Irfan Theater, Oman Convention & Exhibition Centre (OCEC)
items.summary: Get ready for a magical evening with Rasha Rizk, the legendary Golden Voice of Spacetoon! Relive the golden days of childhood through iconic songs, unforgettable memories, and beloved childhood anthems in a nostalgic concert filled with music, emotion, and joy.

items.title: Experience Oman IRONMAN Oman
items.summary: Oman's first full-distance IRONMAN triathlon. Athletes swim 3.8 km at Qurum Beach, cycle 180 km from Muscat to Barka and back, then run a 42.2 km marathon through Muscat's landmarks, marking a historic milestone for sports tourism in the Sultanate.
